description: LOTII Bakehouse is an Indonesian bakery and quick-service café specializing in freshly baked breads, pastries, handcrafted beverages, and ready-to-eat snacks. The menu features both sweet and savory bakery selections, including filled breads, specialty rolls, and coffee-based drinks prepared for dine-in and takeaway customers. Orders are processed through a point-of-sale (POS) system that records transaction details such as the sales reference number, service type, cashier information, purchased items, quantities, pricing, and payment totals. This receipt demonstrates a standard retail bakery transaction with payment completed using QRIS (Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard), Indonesia's nationally standardized QR code payment system that supports cashless transactions through participating banks and digital wallet providers. The overall receipt format reflects the streamlined transaction records commonly issued by modern Indonesian bakery and café businesses.
